annotations.title: Unlink a manually linked pull request

description: Remove a manual finding-to-PR link. Requires write permission and explicit user confirmation. Automatic links cannot be removed with this operation. Does not modify, close, merge or delete the GitHub PR.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

prNodeId.description: Stored prNodeId of a manually linked pull request from get_finding.

name: unlink_finding_pull_request
